music.title: Music.
music.label: THE SOUND OF EVAN CROSS
paragraphs: Blending country, soul, blues, and Americana, Evan Cross turns personal moments into songs about love, resilience, and starting again. His music finds its roots in the everyday: the people we hold close, the roads we take, and the moments that change us.
From quiet reflections to songs that carry a little more fire, every track makes room for vulnerability and hope. Press play, explore the collection, and find a story that feels like your own.

lyrics.title: Lyrics.
lyrics.label: BEHIND THE SONGS
paragraphs: Every song begins with something real: a memory, a question, or a feeling that refuses to fade. For Evan Cross, writing is a way of giving those moments a voice, putting words to what can be difficult to say out loud.
Written in English and French, these stories explore love, heartbreak, self-worth, and the courage to begin again. Step inside the lyrics and spend a little time with the words behind the music.

videos.title: Videos.
videos.label: WATCH. LISTEN. FEEL.
paragraphs: Some stories find another voice through images. This is a place to explore the visual side of Evan Cross Music, where songs, atmosphere, and emotion meet in a different way.
Visit the YouTube channel to discover the music and follow along as this collection grows. Whether a song is new to you or already feels familiar, there is always another way to experience its story.

about.title: About Evan.
about.label: THE PERSON BEHIND THE MUSIC
paragraphs: Evan Cross is a Canadian songwriter and independent artist whose music brings together country, soul, blues, and Americana. Writing in English and French, he draws on the experiences that leave a mark: love, heartbreak, resilience, and the quiet courage it takes to begin again.

His songs make space for honest feelings and imperfect lives. They speak to the small moments that hold us together, the people who give us a reason to keep going, and the hope that something beautiful still lies ahead.
